channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Canadian Dollar steadies at 1.3800 awaiting employment data from US and Canada
item.description: The Canadian Dollar (CAD) holds minor losses against the US Dollar (USD) on Friday, as the USD/CAD pair trades just above 1.3800 after bouncing from two-week lows at 1.3765.

item.title: Indian Rupee outperforms amid strong foreign inflows in FCNR (B) deposits
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) jumps almost 1% higher against the US Dollar (USD) this week. On Friday, the USD/INR pair trades close to its two-month low of 94.29 posted the previous day.

item.title: US Dollar: Short-term downside risks – ING
item.description: ING’s Chris Turner notes that dovish comments from Federal Reserve official Christopher Waller have pushed US yields and the Dollar lower, while supporting equities and high-yielding FX.

item.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: On track to revisit four-year high near 0.7280
item.description: The Australian Dollar (AUD) trades marginally higher at around 0.7203 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Friday. The Aussie pair is broadly firm as the US Dollar remains under pressure, with traders reassessing Federal Reserve (Fed) interest rate expectations.

item.title: Gold pauses after two-day recovery as US NFP looms
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) moves quietly on Friday after two straight days of gains, as traders appear reluctant to take fresh positions ahead of the US Nonfarm Payrolls (NFP) report at 12:30 GMT.

item.title: US August Nonfarm Payrolls set to rebound as markets assess September Fed hike
item.description: The United States (US) Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) is set to release the Nonfarm Payrolls (NFP) data for August on Friday at 12:30 GMT.

item.title: British Pound pulls back from session highs as BoE Bailey tames rate hike hopes
item.description: The British Pound (GBP) has retreated from session highs just below 1.3550 against the US Dollar (USD) during the London trading session, returning to levels near 1.3520 and turning negative on the daily chart.

item.title: Australian Dollar edges higher vs Yen as RBA tightening bets meet BoJ normalization hopes
item.description: AUD/JPY advances on Friday and trades around 112.65 at the time of writing, up 0.39% on the day.

item.title: BoE's Bailey defends central bank flexibility, warns of bond market pressures
item.description: Bank of England (BoE) Governor Andrew Bailey said on Friday that monetary policymakers have some discretion over how quickly they bring inflation back to target, while stressing that returning inflation to the target remains imperative.

item.title: Canadian Dollar: Data volatility guides Bank of Canada – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank analysts Norman Liebke and Michael Pfister report that the Bank of Canada kept its policy rate at 2.25% but adopted a more hawkish tone as inflation risks rise from higher energy prices and trade tensions with the US.

item.title: Gold Price Forecast: XAU/USD recovery stalls below $4.500 awaiting US Nonfarm Payrolls
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) trades flat at the $4,470 area on Friday, as the previous two days’ rebound from $4,280 failed to find acceptance above the $4,500 psychological area.

item.title: US Dollar Index: Two-way risks within bearish channel – OCBC
item.description: OCBC’s Christopher Wong notes that the Dollar Index (DXY) has eased alongside lower UST yields after Fed Governor Waller signalled a preference to keep rates unchanged in September if disinflation persists.

item.title: Silver price today: Silver falls, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Silver prices (XAG/USD) fell on Friday, according to FXStreet data. Silver trades at $66.67 per troy ounce, down 0.46% from the $66.98 it cost on Thursday.

item.title: Indian Rupee: Rate hike path supports currency – Societe Generale
item.description: Societe Generale strategists note that the Indian Rupee (INR) rallied to its strongest level against the US Dollar (USD) since late June, helped by active RBI intervention and sizeable FX mobilisation flows.

item.title: Experts agree: US-Iran tensions are far from over as Hormuz risks return
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI), futures on NYMEX, drops to near $88.65 while struggling to move above the $90 mark during the European trading session on Friday.

item.title: Euro remains steady above 1.1600, unfazed by downbeat Eurozone Retail Sales
item.description: The Euro (EUR) remains hovering between 1.1600 and 1.1630 against the US Dollar (USD) on Friday, hardly affected by the release of a disappointing Eurozone Retail Sales report earlier in the day.

item.title: Japanese Yen: Stronger yen driven by fundamentals – MUFG
item.description: MUFG’s Lee Hardman notes that the Japanese Yen (JPY) has strengthened sharply, pushing USD/JPY back towards the 155.00 support level that has held several times this year.

item.title: British Pound: Budget risks weigh on Sterling – Rabobank
item.description: Rabobank’s Senior FX Strategist Jane Foley highlights that the British Pound (GBP) is vulnerable as global bond market pressure focuses on high-debt countries facing elections or budget talks.

item.title: Eurozone Retail Sales decline unexpectedly 0.6% MoM in July
item.description: Eurozone Retail Sales contracted at a 0.6% pace Month-on-Month (MoM) in June, while they were anticipated to rise by 0.3%. June's data revised higher to 0.2% from -0.3%.

item.title: Euro: Gradual recovery from Warsh sell-off against US Dollar – ING
item.description: ING’s Chris Turner writes that EUR/USD is grinding higher as markets reverse the earlier sell-off triggered by Kevin Warsh’s speech, with the pair moving back toward 1.1650. A softer Dollar backdrop versus EMFX and pro-growth G10 currencies supports the Euro.

item.title: GBP/USD Price Forecast: Bulls turn cautious as 1.3550 cap gains ahead of US NFP
item.description: The GBP/USD pair attracts some buyers for the second straight day, though it lacks follow-through and remains capped near mid-1.3500s through the early European session on Friday.

item.title: Hungarian Forint: Forint supported by possible MNB pause – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Tatha Ghose highlights a sharp Forint rally after a Bloomberg report suggested the National Bank of Hungary may pause rate cuts on 22 September and consider lowering its inflation target. While unconfirmed, this aligns with the bank’s less dovish August message.

item.title: Euro recovery against Japanese Yen stalls despite upbeat German Factory data
item.description: The Euro (EUR) posts moderate gains against the Japanese Yen (JPY) on Friday, with the EUR/JPY pair trimming some losses after a whopping 500-pip sell-off in the previous two days. Euro bulls, however, remain capped below 182.00, after bouncing up from one-month lows at 180.53 on Thursday.

item.title: Gold extends the range play above $4,450 as traders look to US NFP for Fed rate cues
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) extends its sideways price moves and trades above the $4,450 level through the first half of the European session on Friday.

item.title: Japanese Yen: 160 seen as credible intervention deterrent against US Dollar – BNY
item.description: Geoff Yu at BNY highlights that USD/JPY around 160 has become a credible deterrent level for FX participants, even without clear evidence of official intervention.

item.title: Equities: Rally on dovish Fed tone – Deutsche Bank
item.description: Deutsche Bank reports that US equities, led by the S&P 500, rallied as dovish remarks from Fed Governor Waller offset stronger US data. The S&P 500 logged its best day in nearly a month and moved close to record highs, supported by gains in the Magnificent 7 and easing energy prices.

item.title: Dow Jones futures steady as traders await US Nonfarm Payrolls
item.description: Dow Jones futures inch lower by 0.06% to trade near 53,710 during European hours on Friday. Meanwhile, S&P 500 futures advance by 0.06% to trade near 7,760, while Nasdaq 100 futures rise by 0.38% to trade around 29,640.

item.title: British Pound rebounds swiftly from one-month low against broadly weaker Yen
item.description: The GBP/JPY cross stages a goodish intraday recovery from the vicinity of the 210.00 psychological mark, though it remains on track to register heavy weekly losses.

item.title: USD/JPY Price Forecast: US Dollar recovery is likely to be tested at 156.70 area
item.description: The Japanese Yen (JPY) is trimming some gains against the US Dollar (USD) on Friday, but still on track to its strongest weekly performance since July’s US-Japan coordinated intervention.

item.title: Gold: Rebound on softer Fed expectations – OCBC
item.description: OCBC’s Christopher Wong reports Gold rebounded over 2% towards 4510 as Waller’s comments led markets to pare September Fed hike expectations, lowering UST yields and the Dollar.
